newsitem.title: SPAIN: Mapfre sees 1996 EPS in line with 1995.
newsitem.headline: Mapfre sees 1996 EPS in line with 1995.

text.p: Spanish insurance group Corporacion Mapfre's earnings per share (EPS) in 1996 will not be substantially different from last year's 352.1 pesetas per share, general manager Domingo Sugranyes said on Friday.
From that point EPS will grow considerably, Sugranyes predicted.
"Definitively, in the next few years earnings per share will grow substantially, but this year performance will be flat," he told journalists.
Mapfre expects its revenues from direct insurance and reinsurance to rise to 417.6 billion pesetas, versus 344.73 billion pesetas in 1995.
Total revenues could reach 453.2 billion pesetas versus 376.8 billion last year.
